description: Source code implementing DER parsing functions for ASN.1 data types, including booleans, integers, time formats, and string types, with validation and conversion utilities.

classes.name: BitString
classes.description: Represents a DER-encoded bit string with validation for unused bits and bit assertions.

classes.name: GeneralizedTime
classes.description: Represents a generalized time structure with validation and comparison operators.

methods.name: ParseBool
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseBoolRelaxed
methods.description: Parses a boolean value with relaxed BER interpretation.

methods.name: IsValidInteger
methods.description: Validates if input is a valid ASN.1 integer and determines if it is negative.

methods.name: ParseUint64
methods.description: Parses a 64-bit unsigned integer from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseUint8
methods.description: Parses an 8-bit unsigned integer from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseUTCTime
methods.description: Parses a UTC time value from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Parses a generalized time value from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseIA5String
methods.description: Parses an IA5 string from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseVisibleString
methods.description: Parses a visible string from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParsePrintableString
methods.description: Parses a printable string from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseTeletexStringAsLatin1
methods.description: Converts a Teletex string to Latin-1 and then to UTF-8.

methods.name: ParseUniversalString
methods.description: Parses a universal string (UCS-4) from DER encoding.

methods.name: ParseBmpString
methods.description: Parses a BMP string (UCS-2) from DER encoding.
